tasks.title: Add personal_usage service layer (queries + aggregation)
tasks.notes: Exactly 3 async functions, each one bounded SELECT (DATA-DESIGN.md §8): (1) fetch_card_totals(db, user_id) -> to-date SELECT count(*), sum(duration_seconds), sum(tokens) FROM user_sessions WHERE user_id=:id -- coerce SUM's NULL (zero rows) to 0 before building cards; build_cards(...) zips the fixed 4-tuple (glyph,label,iconBg,iconColor order: Sessions, Total time, Total tokens, Avg tokens/session; literal values sourced from the decoded ARC/DEV/PMD mockups at implementation time, mirroring overview.py's _SUMMARY_CARD_GLYPHS_LABELS) against format_number(sessions)/format_duration(total_duration_seconds // 60)/format_number(total_tokens)/format_number(compute_average(total_tokens, sessions)) -- compute_average (app/services/rollup_compute.py) gives 0.0 when sessions==0 (SHP-02-FR-5), never None. (2) fetch_daily_token_series(db, user_id, range_value) -> grouped SELECT date_trunc('day', started_at), sum(tokens) FROM user_sessions WHERE user_id=:id AND started_at >= range_to_start(range_value) GROUP BY 1; a pure zero-padding helper walks every day in [range_to_start(range_value), now] producing one DailyTokenPoint per day (missing days -> value=format_number(0)='0'), then period_total=format_number(sum) and avg_per_day=format_number(sum/num_days). (3) fetch_commands_breakdown(db, user_id, range_value) -> grouped SELECT command, count(*) FROM usage_events WHERE \"user\"=:id AND ts >= range_to_start(range_value) GROUP BY command; build_commands_panel(...) computes max_count = max(counts, default=0), total_runs=format_number(sum(counts)), items=[CommandEntry(command=c, count=n, barStyle=bar_style_for_share(n, max_count)) for c,n in rows] (empty items when no in-range events). Module docstring documents the user_sessions-vs-usage_events table split (C-2/D-01) and the bar-formula AC3-vs-mockup discrepancy (SHP-02-FR-3), per REQUIREMENTS.md Documentation requirements.
